title: Commands and subcommands
description: One row per mach command or subcommand: usage, summary, which half it belongs to, whether it works, writes and takes --apply / --dry-run.
source: libexec/mach-* headers (mach-usage, mach-summary, mach-group, mach-subcommands, mach-status, mach-writes)

title: Flags per command
description: Every flag found in the command usage lines, with its argument, meaning and default; plus the global options.
source: libexec/mach-* usage and mach-flag headers; bin/mach

title: Functions in lib/ and libexec/
description: Every top-level function, class and method in the python and bash sources, with the one-line purpose from its docstring or comment.
source: lib/*, libexec/* (python ast, bash function definitions)

title: Configuration keys
description: Every key in config/config.example.toml and the built-in defaults, with the default and what it does; plus the env overrides.

title: Destinations
description: Where prompts and notes can be sent: subsystem role destinations and `mach note` destinations.

title: Prompt-document templates
description: The generic prompt-document templates a machine-flows tree can hold, what each is for and which command ingests it.

title: Subsystem units (example)
description: Units of the example subsystem manifest: kind, parent, lead, repo, folder and whether the binding is verified.
